lessons.title: Friendly Word Sounds (Phonics)
lessons.description: Discover playful vowel sounds and rhyme pairs with cheerful animal buddies.
lessons.subject: Reading & Phonics
lessons.summary: Learn short 'a' and 'e' sounds, identify rhyming sounds, and unlock friendly words.

slides.title: Meet Apple the Ant! 🍎🐜
slides.text: The letter 'A' makes a cheerful 'Ah' sound like in Apple and Ant! Say it with me: Ah-Ah-Apple!
slides.tip: Click the speaker button to hear Apple the Ant say the sound!

slides.title: Finding Rhyming Friends 🎵
slides.text: Words that rhyme sound like singing twins at the end. 'Cat' rhymes with 'Hat' and 'Bat'!
slides.tip: Listen carefully to the end sound of each friendly word.

lessons.title: Safari Counting Adventure
lessons.description: Count animals on a sunny savanna expedition and build strong number sense.
lessons.subject: Math
lessons.summary: Practice counting groups of 1 to 10, comparing bigger and smaller groups, and basic addition.

slides.title: Welcome to the Animal Safari! 🌿
slides.text: Today we are helping Ranger Leo count the animals at the waterhole. 3 giraffes plus 2 zebras makes 5 animal friends!
slides.tip: Touch each animal one by one as you count out loud.

slides.title: Number Friends Balance ⚖️
slides.text: When two sides have the same number, they are equal! Like 4 paw prints and 4 paws.
slides.tip: Grouping into pairs makes counting quick and fun!

lessons.title: Understanding Big Feelings
lessons.description: Explore feelings, face expressions, and calming breathing techniques with Buddy.
lessons.subject: Emotions & Social
lessons.summary: Recognize happy, worried, excited, and overwhelmed feelings. Learn the Balloon Breath.

slides.title: Feelings are like Weather ☀️🌧️
slides.text: Every person experiences feelings. Some days feel sunny and cheerful, and some days feel stormy. All feelings are okay to have!
slides.tip: Naming how you feel helps your brain feel calm and safe.

slides.title: The Magic Balloon Breath 🎈
slides.text: When feeling worried or frustrated, breathe in deep like inflating a gentle balloon, hold for 2, and blow out gently like a cloud.
slides.tip: Try doing one balloon breath right now!

lessons.title: Curious Planet: Plants & Sunshine
lessons.description: See how seeds sprout into green leaves with water, soil, and golden sunshine.
lessons.subject: Science & Nature
lessons.summary: Understand what living plants need to grow and match garden tools to their jobs.

slides.title: A Tiny Seed's Journey 🌰
slides.text: Under the cozy dark soil, a seed drinks water drops and starts reaching little roots down and green shoots up toward the sunshine!
slides.tip: Plants make their own energy using warm rays of light.

lessons.title: Memory Galaxy: Patterns & Focus
lessons.description: Train working memory and visual focus with stellar pattern sequences.
lessons.subject: Focus & Logic
lessons.summary: Match space patterns, find hidden constellations, and practice mindful focus.

slides.title: Look Closely at the Star Constellations ⭐
slides.text: Patterns repeat in rhythm: Blue Star, Yellow Moon, Blue Star... what comes next? You got it!
slides.tip: Take your time. There is never any rush!

activities.title: Which Word Rhymes with 'CAT'?
activities.question: Listen and choose: which word has the same rhyming sound as 'CAT'?
activities.promptAudio: Which word rhymes with CAT? Cat... Bat, Sun, or Dog?
activities.hint: Listen to the ending sound: C-AT. Which friend ends with -AT?
activities.explanation: Great job! 'Cat' and 'Bat' both end with the cheerful sound '-at'!

activities.title: Match the Letter Sounds to Pictures
activities.question: Connect each beginning letter sound to the matching picture buddy!
activities.promptAudio: Match each letter to the animal that starts with its sound.
activities.hint: Say each animal's name out loud. What sound do you hear first?
activities.explanation: Super star! A for Alligator, B for Bear, and C for Cat!

activities.title: Sort the Safari Friends by Size
activities.question: Sort the animals into 'Small Animals' and 'Big Animals' groups!
activities.promptAudio: Put each friendly animal in the right basket: Small or Big.
activities.hint: Think about who could fit inside a backpack and who is bigger than a car!
activities.explanation: Awesome sorting! You organized all the safari animals correctly!

activities.title: Identify the Happy Smile Face
activities.question: Which friendly buddy looks HAPPY and smiling?
activities.promptAudio: Touch the face that shows a happy, smiling friend.

options.label: Smiling Sunny
options.description: Big warm smile with bright eyes

activities.hint: Look for the wide smile and cheerful sparkling eyes!
activities.explanation: You spotted it! A bright smile shows joy and happiness!

activities.title: Buddy's Calming Adventure
activities.question: Buddy the Owl feels nervous before flying in the wind. What should Buddy do?
activities.promptAudio: Help Buddy choose what to do when feeling nervous.
activities.story: Buddy's little wings are trembling. The wind is whooshing through the trees. Buddy's heart is thumping fast.

options.text: Take 3 deep Balloon Breaths and tell a friend 🎈
Hold feelings inside and hide in the dark forever 🙈

activities.hint: Remember the calming balloon breath we practiced in the lesson!
activities.explanation: Wonderful decision! Taking slow deep breaths and talking to someone you trust always helps calm nervous feelings.

activities.title: Cosmic Memory Match
activities.question: Find all the matching cosmic cards!
activities.promptAudio: Flip the cards to find matching celestial buddies.
activities.hint: Pay close attention to where each shape is hiding when you turn it over.
activities.explanation: Outstanding focus! You matched every pair in the galaxy!

activities.title: Safari Math Puzzle
activities.question: Solve the fruit puzzle: 3 apples + 2 apples = how many apples total?
activities.hint: Put 3 fingers up on one hand, and 2 fingers on the other hand. Count them all together!
activities.explanation: Math champion! 3 + 2 = 5! You got it right!
